_about: Breadth set r7, Python (ARB-163), frozen before any scan. Python applications drawn from GitHub topics ['self-hosted', 'django-application', 'flask-application', 'fastapi', 'web-application', 'webapp', 'dashboard', 'home-automation', 'chatbot', 'discord-bot', 'telegram-bot', 'crawler', 'scraper', 'automation', 'monitoring', 'cms', 'erp', 'saas', 'api-server', 'rag', 'llm-app', 'workflow', 'media-server', 'download-manager', 'bot'], each with >= 1000 stars, pushed since 2026-08-26, not archived/fork/template, an OSI licence, Python >= 60% of bytes, size <= 400000 KB, a .github/workflows directory, no path Windows cannot check out, and not named anywhere in Arbiter's tools, packs, docs or fixtures (r5 and r7 held-out, gold repos, ground-truth sources). Chosen from metadata and file names only; candidates shuffled with seed 20261026, then split with seed 20261027 into 'dev' (45: rule fixes may read these) and 'heldout' (measurement only, never used for tuning). Each repo is pinned to its default-branch HEAD at freeze time.
